answers.moment: When Liam said he fixes broken stuff off Marketplace to save for a house. He got a graphics card for ninety quid with a dead fan, fiver to fix, and it'll sell for two-fifty.
answers.reason: I didn't expect a side hustle like that, and the numbers stuck with me. It also sort of matched what we see at work with tools that are just a flat battery. Clever, tbh.
